title: FBI Photo B11
doc_notes: This document is an FBI submission to AARO containing a redacted infrared still image of a UAP, noting that the timestamp on the image is incorrect due to system settings.

incidents.summary: A grainy monochrome infrared still image showing a small, dark, circular object against a mountainous background, captured by a U.S. military system.
incidents.quote: A small, dark, circular object is visible in the upper right quadrant of the frame.
